impact: Building an imitation-learning method that is both accurate and fast enough for real robots.
bullets: Designed a new imitation-learning algorithm and benchmarked it against Diffusion Policy, Consistency Policy, Implicit BC and regression BC on 7 synthetic, simulated and real tasks (paper under double-blind review at ICRA 2027).
On a real WidowX arm (Push-T) it reached 83.6 IoU, above Implicit BC (73.4), Diffusion Policy (65.6) and regression BC (61.0), with faster inference than Implicit BC and Diffusion Policy.
On LIBERO-Goal from camera images: 93.9% success vs. 84.5% for Diffusion Policy, at 5.5× lower latency.
Built the training pipeline on a SLURM GPU cluster, collected 151 teleoperated demonstrations, wrote the real-robot deployment client and shadow-tested every policy before giving it control.
Ran the real-robot evaluation of a fine-tuned π0.5 vision-language-action model on a Franka Panda arm (co-author of an ICLR 2027 submission).

impact: Co-built the AI tool that restored more than 200,000 photographs damaged by the 2024 Valencia floods.
bullets: Co-developed a diffusion-based restoration web app in Python and Gradio, with a batch processor.
Built and labeled a 250-image training set and fine-tuned SegFormer to find damaged regions: 30% lower latency and 20% better expert-rated quality than the YOLO/SAM2 pipeline.
Built an identity-preservation pipeline, rated above 90% identity preservation by experts.
The restoration department used the app on more than 200,000 images with 98% less manual effort.
Published at [AAAI-26 (Demonstration Track)](https://doi.org/10.1609/aaai.v40i48.42383); I presented the demo in person in Singapore.

impact: Trained a reinforcement-learning levitation controller for the Hyperloop UPV vehicle.
bullets: Built a Gymnasium vehicle-dynamics simulator and trained a Soft Actor-Critic controller in it, with curriculum learning, domain randomization, sensor-noise and latency modeling.
The policy controlled 10 coils, 5-DoF, and ran in 0.06 ms on an STM32H7 microcontroller, with 94% less compute than the cascaded PID.
The simulator enabled automated testing and cut manual parameter tuning by 99%.
This work became my bachelor's thesis.
